# KafkaGCTimeHigh

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-jvm](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-jvm/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** Broker <kafka_broker> spends more than 10 % of its time in GC pauses

Stop-the-world garbage collection on <pod> takes more than 10 % of wall-clock time: request latency rises, ISR shrinks and session timeouts follow. Check heap after GC and allocation rate.

## Impact

Stop-the-world pauses add latency to every request; long pauses expire sessions and shrink ISRs.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · JVM → average pause, collections per second (any Old Generation = full GC), allocation rate.

## Mitigation

- More heap if heap after GC is high; otherwise tune G1 (MaxGCPauseMillis) or reduce allocation (smaller fetch sizes, fewer connections).

## Expression

```promql
kafka:jvm_gc_pause:ratio_rate5m > 0.1
```
